definition_en: boldness or daring, often with a suggestion of shameless impudence; the nerve to do something surprising
core_image: 敢开口、敢伸手、敢越线的那份「胆」，既可敬也可憎
scene: 会议刚定下不许再议，实习生竟当场推翻了整个方案。The intern had the audacity to challenge the director's final decision.
sceneCN: 这里 audacity 指「放肆、胆敢」（第 2 个义项：近乎冒犯的胆量）；句意：实习生竟胆敢质疑主管的最终决定。

collocations.zh: 胆敢去做；竟然好意思去做

derivatives.zh: 大胆的；放肆的（audacity 的形容词形式）

senses.title: Admirable boldness
senses.definition: impressive boldness and willingness to take risks
senses.definitionCN: 令人赞叹的大胆与冒险意愿
senses.example: The audacity of the expedition impressed the whole nation.
senses.exampleCN: 那次远征的胆识令举国叹服。
senses.why: The Latin root audacia covers daring of every kind; this is its bright face.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语词根 audacia 涵盖一切「敢」；这是它光明的一面。

senses.title: Shameless impudence
senses.definition: boldness that disregards respect or propriety, often causing offense
senses.definitionCN: 不顾礼数与分寸的大胆，常令人反感
senses.example: He had the audacity to lie to the judge's face.
senses.exampleCN: 他竟厚颜到当着法官的面撒谎。
senses.why: The same Latin word carried contempt in Rome too; daring without shame turns ugly.
senses.whyCN: 同一个拉丁词在罗马也带轻蔑意味；没有羞耻的胆量便变得丑陋。

senses.title: Boldness of a plan or design
senses.definition: the striking boldness of a scheme, proposal, or artistic design
senses.definitionCN: 方案、提议或艺术构思令人瞩目的大胆
senses.example: The audacity of the bridge design still amazes engineers.
senses.exampleCN: 那座桥的设计之大胆至今仍令工程师惊叹。
senses.why: Boldness lives not only in people but in the plans they dare to draw.
senses.whyCN: 胆量不只属于人，也属于人敢画出来的方案。

senses.title: Nerve in speech
senses.definition: the cheek or gall shown in a remark or question
senses.definitionCN: 在言辞或提问中显出的冒犯式胆量
senses.example: Where does she get the audacity to ask such a thing?
senses.exampleCN: 她哪来的胆子问这种话？
senses.why: In questions of indignation, audacity names the nerve the speaker resents.
senses.whyCN: 在愤慨的反问中，audacity 指的就是说话者所厌恶的那份「胆敢」。

senses.title: Boldness of a crime or exploit
senses.titleCN: 罪行或壮举的胆大包天
senses.definition: the amazing daring of an outrageous act or exploit
senses.definitionCN: 骇人听闻的行动或壮举所展现的惊人胆量
senses.example: The audacity of the daylight robbery stunned the city.
senses.exampleCN: 光天化日抢劫的胆大包天震动了全城。
senses.why: When daring shocks society, the word records both admiration and alarm.
senses.whyCN: 当胆量震动社会时，这个词同时记录了惊叹与警觉。

senses.title: Political or moral daring
senses.titleCN: 政治或道德上的敢言敢为
senses.definition: boldness in a cause, such as hope, protest, or reform
senses.definitionCN: 在希望、抗议、改革等事业中的敢作敢为
senses.example: The speech was remembered for its audacity of hope.
senses.exampleCN: 那次演讲因「希望的胆量」而被人铭记。
senses.why: Modern rhetoric recast the old word as courage against long odds.
senses.whyCN: 现代修辞把这个老词重新铸成对抗悬殊劣势的勇气。

senses.title: Creative daring
senses.definition: daring originality in art, music, or literature
senses.definitionCN: 艺术、音乐或文学上的大胆独创
senses.example: The novel's audacity lies in telling the story backwards.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说的大胆之处在于倒叙全篇。
senses.why: Artists earn the word when their risks remake a form rather than break it.
senses.whyCN: 当冒险重塑而非仅仅打破一种形式时，艺术家便赢得这个词。

senses.title: Boldness of the weak
senses.definition: surprising boldness shown by someone in a low or weak position
senses.definitionCN: 地位低微或弱势者显出的惊人胆量
senses.example: The audacity of the small village refusing the empire amazed historians.
senses.exampleCN: 小小村庄竟敢拒绝帝国，其胆量令史家惊叹。
senses.why: Daring against power reads as either noble courage or unpardonable nerve, depending on whose side you stand.
senses.whyCN: 对权势的「敢」，站在哪一边看，或为高贵的勇气，或为不可饶恕的放肆。

intro.en: Audacity comes from Latin audacia, boldness, formed on audax, bold, from the verb audere, to dare; English borrowed it in the mid-sixteenth century together with audacious.
intro.cn: audacity 出自拉丁语 audacia「大胆」，该词由 audax「大胆的」构成，而 audax 又源于动词 audere「敢」；16 世纪中叶英语与 audacious 一同将其借入。

items.en: The root *awej- meant to be eager, to dare, the seed of every bold word in this family.
items.cn: 词根 *awej- 意为「渴望、敢于」，是这个家族一切大胆之词的种子。

items.en: audere meant to dare; audax, bold, was its adjective, with genitive audacis.
items.cn: 拉丁语 audere 意为「敢」；其形容词 audax 意为「大胆的」，属格为 audacis。

items.en: audacia meant boldness, used in praise of courage and in blame of shameless forwardness alike.
items.cn: audacia 意为「大胆」，罗马人既用它赞勇气，也用它斥无耻的放肆。

items.en: audacity entered English in the mid-sixteenth century with both senses intact.
items.cn: 16 世纪中叶 audacity 进入英语，双重含义原样带入。

items.en: The phrase the audacity to do became the standard way to name someone's improper daring.
items.cn: the audacity to do 一式成为指称他人冒犯式大胆的标准说法。

items.en: Modern usage swings between admiration and outrage, from the audacity of hope to how dare you have the audacity.
items.cn: 现代用法在赞叹与愤慨之间摇摆：从「希望的胆量」到「你竟敢如此放肆」。

note.en: Group one collects look-alikes around the dare root and the aud- spelling; group two collects nearby boldness nouns.
note.cn: 第一组收「敢」词根及 aud- 拼写相关的形近词；第二组收相邻的「大胆」类名词。

entries.definition: the adjective of the same family: bold or impudent.
entries.definitionCN: 同族形容词：大胆的；放肆的。

entries.definition: able to be heard, from Latin audire, to hear; only the aud- spelling is shared, not the root.
entries.definitionCN: 听得见的，出自拉丁语 audire「听」；仅拼写同以 aud- 开头，词根不同。

entries.definition: firmness of grip or purpose, built like audacity on a Latin adjective plus -itas.
entries.definitionCN: 坚韧；与 audacity 同为「拉丁形容词 + -itas」结构的名词。

entries.definition: truthfulness, another -acity noun from Latin verax, truthful.
entries.definitionCN: 真实；另一例 -acity 名词，出自拉丁语 verax「说真话的」。

entries.definition: the plain term for daring, without the tinge of offense.
entries.definitionCN: 大胆的中性说法，不带冒犯色彩。

entries.definition: audacity in its impudent sense; what people accuse others of having.
shameless boldness, bitter as its name.
entries.definitionCN: 厚颜无耻；如词义般苦涩的说法。

entries.definition: excessive boldness, recklessly disregarding risk or propriety.
entries.definitionCN: 鲁莽；轻率的大胆，不计风险与体统。

entries.definition: offensive boldness in the face of authority.
entries.definitionCN: 当着权威面显出的冒犯式无耻。

normalIntro.en: audacity is audacious as a noun: one root, two faces, courage and cheek.
normalIntro.cn: audacity 是 audacious 的名词形态：一个词根、两张面孔——勇气与放肆。

normal.en: audacity comes from audax, bold; the ax-to-acity shift mirrors verax to veracity.
normal.cn: audacity 出自 audax；从 -ax 到 -acity 的转变与 verax 变 veracity 同理。

normal.en: have the audacity to do is the classic collocation for someone going too far.
normal.cn: have the audacity to do 是形容某人「胆敢过分」的经典搭配。

normal.en: The -acity ending marks Latin bold-family nouns like tenacity and sagacity.
normal.cn: -acity 词尾标志着一类拉丁名词：tenacity（坚韧）、sagacity（睿智）。

normal.en: Read it as aud-ac-ity: dare, plus noun ending, plus state of being.
normal.cn: 拆成 aud-ac-ity：敢 + 名词词尾 + 状态。

normal.en: One word, two verdicts: praise for heroes, blame for the rude.
normal.cn: 一词两判：给英雄的赞美，给无礼者的斥责。

abstract.en: Picture a hand knocking on a forbidden door, twice, loudly.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手敲响一扇禁门，敲了两遍，很响。

abstract.en: The word lands heavy, like a gasp in a silent room.
abstract.cn: 这个词落地很重，像寂静房间里的一声抽气。

abstract.en: Audacity is courage that forgot to ask permission.
abstract.cn: audacity 是忘了请求许可的勇气。

examples.en: Nobody expected the audacity of launching the product on a rival's launch day.
examples.cn: 没人料到竟有人胆大到选在对手发布当天发布自家产品。

examples.en: Her audacity in court won the case but lost her allies.
examples.cn: 她在法庭上的大胆为案件赢得了胜利，却失去了盟友。

examples.en: The audacity of the escape plan made it a legend among prisoners.
examples.cn: 越狱计划之大胆使它在囚犯中成为传奇。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「傲刀sister」——傲慢的姐姐刀子嘴，什么话都敢说，放肆得很

root: 出自拉丁语 audacia「大胆」（audax「大胆的」+ 抽象名词后缀 -ia），核心为动词 audere「敢」；16 世纪中叶经 audacious 同批借入英语，属「敢」词根一系，词源确凿。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses map one boldness noun from heroism to impudence: admirable daring, offensive nerve, and the daring of plans, words, crimes, causes, art, and the weak.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描绘一个「胆量」名词从英雄气到放肆形的全程：可敬的胆识、冒犯的放肆，以及计划、言辞、罪行、事业、艺术与弱者身上的「敢」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the nerve to knock on a forbidden door.
core.cn: 核心意象：敲响禁门的那份胆量。

branches.en: THE NOBLE SIDE: courage of heroes and of the weak who refuse.
branches.cn: 高贵一面：英雄之勇与弱者拒绝之勇。

branches.en: THE NERVE SIDE: the audacity to lie, to ask, to presume.
branches.cn: 放肆一面：说谎、开口、僭越的胆敢。

branches.en: BOLD WORKS: daring designs and shocking exploits.
branches.cn: 大胆之作：惊世的设计与行径。

branches.en: THE CAUSE SIDE: hope and protest armed with boldness.
branches.cn: 事业一面：以胆量武装的希望与抗争。

branches.en: THE ART SIDE: originality that risks everything.
branches.cn: 艺术一面：敢于押上一切的创新。

intro.en: audacity is the noun built on audax with the Latin -itas ending; the dare root aud- is its whole engine.
intro.cn: audacity 是在 audax 上加拉丁 -itas 词尾构成的名词；「敢」的词根 aud- 是全词的发动机。

latinIntro.en: Latin audere, to dare, anchors the family: audax, audacia, and English audacity and audacious.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 audere「敢」是家族之锚：audax、audacia，以及英语的 audacity、audacious。

items.meaningCN: 表性质状态的名词词尾

items.example: question the veracity of the report
